gaps.explanation: p6-7 governmental funds statement prints Transfers in 107,334 (General 100,000 + Street 7,334). detail[] has the General Fund Departments combining schedule, which prints transfers between General Fund departments gross: Administrative 100,000, Police 66,000, Fire 65,567, Ambulance 27,500, Recreation 131,972, Museum 27,500, Library 87,083, Cemetery 11,000 = 516,622, plus Street 7,334 = 523,956. 516,622 - 100,000 = 416,622 are department-to-department transfers inside the General Fund (matched by the same 416,622 extra transfers out); as printed, no fix.

p6 General Fund Transfers out (7,334). The departments schedule prints Administrative (404,222), Fire (6,717), Ambulance (13,017) = (423,956); 423,956 - 7,334 = 416,622 = the intra-General Fund department transfers that also appear as transfers in. Gross by department, net 0; no fix.

No proprietary schedule; p10-11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns (Internal Service Fund excluded). JSON receipts = Sales + Other revenue + Interest income + City sales tax. Electric 3,610,133+16,952+20,906 = 3,647,991; Water 317,737+17,602+2,494+49,674 = 387,507; Sewer 298,435+1,199 = 299,634; Trash 204,044+756+111 = 204,911; total 4,540,043 = statement 4,540,043.
